content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Guides gumroad

Gumroad, Stripe, and PayPal offer different features and pricing plans, but they all share a common limitation: they are not available in certain countries. Gumroad charges a 3.5% + 30¢ per sale fee, while Stripe charges 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction for credit card payments. PayPal's fees vary depending on the country and type of transaction. In contrast, NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment processor, charges a flat 0.5% fee for all transactions and is available in over 300 countries. Additionally, NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Pages and other infrastructure providers, enabling creators to build a fully customized and scalable payment solution.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth, leaving a significant proportion of the global population without access to its services. PayPal's limitations are equally restrictive, with a history of account suspensions and indefinite freezes. Gumroad's limitations are less well-documented, but it is clear that the platform is not a viable option for creators in many countries. In contrast, NOWPayments is available in over 300 countries, making it a reliable option for creators in restricted regions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical considerations for digital creators. Gumroad's 3.5% + 30¢ per sale fee is higher than Stripe's 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction fee, while NOWPayments' flat 0.5% fee is significantly lower. Payment speed is also a concern, with Gumroad's payment delays and Stripe's potential for delayed payments. NOWPayments, on the other hand, enables instant payment processing and delivery, making it an attractive option for creators who need fast and reliable payment solutions.
NOWPayments is a reliable payment processor available in over 300 countries.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are essential aspects of a robust payment solution. Gumroad's ownership model is unclear, while Stripe's ownership model is restrictive. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers full ownership and control to creators, enabling them to automate payment processing and delivery using Cloudflare Pages and other infrastructure providers. This means that creators can deliver digital products instantly, without relying on third-party intermediaries.

Choosing the right architecture for your digital business requires careful consideration of your needs and goals. If you're looking for a reliable and scalable payment solution, NOWPayments is an excellent choice. If you're already invested in the Stripe or Gumroad ecosystem, it may be more challenging to make a switch.
